policy: Usable partition workers and cached lookup batches; shared sizing and resource checks unchanged

confirmation: Same flags for before/final binaries, mixed order, one warm-up and three measured repetitions; fsync and checksum outside timing

final_policy: Eight cached lookup batches; private scan-volume guard remains conservative, without a guessed CPU/I/O conversion factor
